 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rotations = [
        [row[:] for row in grid],
        [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])],  # clockwise
        [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]],       # 180 degrees
        [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1], # counterclockwise
    ]
    tl, tr, br, bl = rotations
    return [tl[r] + tr[r] for r in range(h)] + [bl[r] + br[r] for r in range(h)]
",
